title: NSW’s latest news Instagram account has an unlikely group behind it: the Labor party
summary_full: Expert warns of ‘huge loophole in political communication laws’ as state government among parties presenting accounts as unaffiliated news sourcesGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast“Breaking,” a reel from the Instagram account nswnewsroom reads. “Another Liberal MP quits, almost a third now gone.”The post looks like it could have been made by a media outlet. It cites the source as the Daily Telegraph and Jordan Lane, a New South Wales MP, who is the sixth sitting Liberal member to announce they won’t re-contest their seat at the March 2027 election.Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
